script_text: The wolf is calling across a moonlit divide — and the cosmos is listening. Spirit Animals bridges your soul and the natural world, ruled by Neptune in water — the element of deep intuition, dreams, and emotional mysticism that shapes your inner landscape. Neptune conjunct Jupiter in your 9th House expands spiritual vision this month, while Mars squares your 10th House career sector, demanding bold decisive action before autumn arrives. Venus enters your 7th House on September 12th, bringing a transformative love connection that challenges your independence. Chiron retrograde in your 12th House reveals old wounds around solitude and self-worth — the North Node urges you to release attachments that no longer serve your soul's evolution. Meditate with wolf imagery on September 9th to align with this transit. Share this with someone who needs to hear their spirit animal's message today.
